{{Quote|Ship's log says the crew abandoned ship right after takeoff.|Khurgee|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 3">[[Star Wars (1977) 3|''Star Wars'' (1977) 3]]</ref>}}
A '''ship's log''' was a record of what had transpired aboard a starship. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] faked the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] log to read that the crew had abandoned ship before the freighter was caught by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]]. To seemingly validate this claim, he jettisonned some [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]].
